---
title: "Patch supplementary figures — normal2mci scatter & ES correlation"
---

## Overview

Apply publication theming to the supplementary normal-to-MCI scatter plots and effect-size correlation panel, and save each as a high-resolution PNG.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, ggtext, install = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-theme

source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
set_pub_geom_defaults()
```

## Load RDS plots

```{r}
#| label: load-rds

sct_DMP_suppl <- read_rds(here("normal2mci_focused/output/scatter_DMP_suppl.rds"))
sct_extended_DMP_suppl <- read_rds(here("normal2mci_focused/output/scatter_extended_DMP_suppl.rds"))
line_plot_ES_corr_suppl <- read_rds(here("normal2mci_focused/output/line_plot_ES_corr_suppl.rds"))
```

## Effect size comparison with normal2incid for DMPs

```{r}
#| label: fig-sup-normal2incid-DMP

sct_DMP_suppl$normal2incid <- rescale_layer_params(
  sct_DMP_suppl$normal2incid, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6
)

ggsave(here("normal2mci_focused/patch_figures/output/fig_sup_normal2incid_DMP.png"),
       sct_DMP_suppl$normal2incid,
       width = 6.5, height = 4.9, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Effect size comparison with normal2incid for extended DMPs

```{r}
#| label: fig-sup-normal2incid-extended-DMP

sct_extended_DMP_suppl$mci2incid_vs_normal2incid <- rescale_layer_params(
  sct_extended_DMP_suppl$mci2incid_vs_normal2incid, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6
)
sct_extended_DMP_suppl$normal2mci_vs_normal2incid <- rescale_layer_params(
  sct_extended_DMP_suppl$normal2mci_vs_normal2incid, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6
)

fig_sup_normal2incid_extended_DMP <- sct_extended_DMP_suppl$mci2incid_vs_normal2incid +
  sct_extended_DMP_suppl$normal2mci_vs_normal2incid +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, guides = "collect", axes = "collect", axis_titles = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

ggsave(here("normal2mci_focused/patch_figures/output/fig_sup_normal2incid_extended_DMP.png"),
       fig_sup_normal2incid_extended_DMP,
       width = 6.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Effect size comparison with mci2incid for extended DMPs

```{r}
#| label: fig-sup-mci2incid-extended-DMP

sct_extended_DMP_suppl$prev_vs_mci2incid <- rescale_layer_params(
  sct_extended_DMP_suppl$prev_vs_mci2incid, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6
)
sct_extended_DMP_suppl$normal2mci_vs_mci2incid <- rescale_layer_params(
  sct_extended_DMP_suppl$normal2mci_vs_mci2incid, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6
)

fig_sup_mci2incid_extended_DMP <- sct_extended_DMP_suppl$prev_vs_mci2incid +
  sct_extended_DMP_suppl$normal2mci_vs_mci2incid +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, guides = "collect", axes = "collect", axis_titles = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

ggsave(here("normal2mci_focused/patch_figures/output/fig_sup_mci2incid_extended_DMP.png"),
       fig_sup_mci2incid_extended_DMP,
       width = 6.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Effect size correlation comparison between normal2mci and mci2incid

```{r}
#| label: fig-sup-ES-corr
fs::dir_create(here("normal2mci_focused/patch_figures/output"))

line_plot_ES_corr_suppl$normal2mci_vs_mci2incid <- rescale_layer_params(
  line_plot_ES_corr_suppl$normal2mci_vs_mci2incid, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6
)

ggsave(here("normal2mci_focused/patch_figures/output/fig_sup_ES_corr_mci2incid_normal2mci.png"),
       line_plot_ES_corr_suppl$normal2mci_vs_mci2incid,
       width = 6.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Verify output

```{r}
#| label: verify-output

output_files <- fs::dir_ls(
  here("normal2mci_focused/patch_figures/output"),
  glob = "*sup*"
)
fs::file_info(output_files) |>
  select(path, size, modification_time) |>
  mutate(path = basename(path))
```
